3. These appeals challenge the order passed by the learned Single Judge of the High Court of Madhya Pradesh in Criminal Revision No.177/2012 & Misc. Criminal Case No.412 of 2024, whereby the revision was dismissed, and vide another subsequent order, the application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. filed for restoration of the revision to its original number was dismissed.

4. The revision was filed against the concurrent orders passed by the JMFC, Bhind convicting the appellant for the offence punishable under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code and sentencing him to undergo rigorous imprisonment for one year with fine of Rs.1,000/- and the order passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Bhind dismissing the revision filed against the order of the learned JMFC.

5. We are inclined to set aside the impugned orders on the short ground that the revision was heard by the learned Single Judge of the High Court in the absence of the appellant herein or the counsel for the appellant herein.
